remarks: *Charming Compo Beach Rental. Experience the best of Westport living in this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located just steps from Compo Beach and the Longshore Club. Available as a winter/school year rental starting in September 2025 for $10,000/month, also available for August 2025 at $20,000/month. Walk to Compo Beach or enjoy nearby amenities at the Longshore Club, including golf, tennis, and pools. Open-concept living spaces with hardwood floors throughout. The first-floor den with an adjacent full bath can serve as a 4th bedroom or guest room. Fully updated eat-in kitchen perfect for entertaining. Relax by the gas fireplace or unwind in the screened-in porch. The primary suite includes an updated ensuite bath, while two additional bedrooms feature vaulted ceilings and skylights. Outdoor Living: Enjoy the private backyard deck with a BBQ, string lights, and a cozy seating area.  Dogs considered on a case-by-case basis (no cats). Non-smoking home.
